items.description: S0-AD UAS (air-droppable variant for C-130 demo)

notes: SOCOM/USAF development opportunity: S0-AD for C-130 air-drop demo in Fall 2026. Referenced by Dr. Cione (NOAA). TSgt Wolff interested in air-launched/air-dropped UAS capabilities. Internal working meeting held 2026-04-27 with SOCOM and 53rd Weather Squadron to define mission requirements.
